_comment: English locale for LetterAuction. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim. Player numbers, letter tokens ({letter}), coin/number amounts and the bracket examples ([bid 2], [pass], [dog], [Game]) are neutral game syntax and must stay unchanged.

_slots.{current_player}: The player whose turn is next (0 or 1)
_slots.{letters}: A player's collected letters (a list, e.g. [] or ['A', 'B'])
_slots.{letter}: The single letter being auctioned (a game token, do not translate)
_slots.{current_bid}: The current highest bid to beat (integer)
_slots.{action}: The raw action string the player submitted
_slots.{word}: A word submitted by a player (a game token, do not translate)
_slots.{word_value}: The score value of a submitted word (integer)
_slots.{cont}: A neutral continuation message (already localized; do not translate)

prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are currently in the Letter Auction game.
The goal of the game is to strategically bid on letters to form the highest value word. This is how the game works.
You must listen to the gamemaster for guidance to play the game.
The game consists of a series of rounds. In each round, a letter will be put up for auction.
You can bid on the letter using your coins. The player with the highest bid wins the letter.
The letter will be added to your collection, and the coins you bid will be deducted from your total.
This bidding of letters will repeat till all the letters have been auctioned off. You are not rewarded for saving your coins.
After all the letters have been auctioned, you will use the letters to form the highest value english word from the letters won.
The player with the highest value word wins the game.
If you want to bid, submit your bid amount in square brackets like [bid 2] or [bid 10].
If you do not want to bid, submit [pass].
For the submission of the highest value word, you will be prompted at the end of the game to submit them in square brackets like [dog].
Here is your starting information:
Your current coins: {coins}
Your current letters: {letters}

[Game] Player 0 will go first. The first letter for bid: {letter}.
Starting bid is {bid_amount} coin. You can bid any amount of coins, or choose not to bid.

invalid.bad_bid_format: Kutendela kwa muthandeni kusiwe: {action}. Peleka kutendela kwa njia: '[bid <amount>]' au '[pass]'.
invalid.bad_word_format: Kutendela kwa muthandeni kusiwe: {action}. Peleka kutendela kwa njia: '[<word>]'.
invalid.not_enough_coins: Panga lisilo sahihi: {bid_amount}. Wena ule huna ndalama za kutosha.
invalid.bid_too_low: Panga lisilo sahihi: {bid_amount}. Wena ule fanela ku panga zaidi ya panga la sasa la {current_bid}.
invalid.not_a_word: Neno lisilo sahihi: {word}. Tafadhali weka neno sahihi la Kiingereza.
invalid.missing_letter: Neno lisilo sahihi: {word}. Wena ule huna muboko '{letter}'.

turn.bid_more: Muthandeni {current_player}, unataka ku panga muboko '{letter}' kwa zaidi ya {bid_amount}?
turn.start_bid: Muthandeni {current_player}, unataka kuanza panga muboko '{letter}' kwa {bid_amount}?
turn.auction_over: Mapeleka ya thandeni yameisha. Sasa, wathandeni watatumia thandeni zao kupata muthandeni wa thamani ya juu wa kiingelezi kwa thandeni zao. Muthandeni wa muthandeni wa thamani ya juu atashinda muthandeni. Kupeleka muthandeni, peleka mu square brackets kama [dog].

auction.pass_opp_wins: Muthandeni {player_id} ameacha muboko '{letter}'. Muthandeni {opponent_id} atapata muboko '{letter}' kwa {bid_amount}.{cont}
auction.pass_both: Muthandeni {player_id} ameacha muboko '{letter}'. Muthandeni {opponent_id} pia ameacha muboko '{letter}'. Kwa hiyo, hakuna atakayepata muboko.{cont}
auction.bid_opp_pass: Muthandeni {player_id} amepanga {bid_amount} kwa muboko '{letter}'. Kwa kuwa Muthandeni {opponent_id} ameacha muboko '{letter}', Muthandeni {player_id} atapata muboko kwa {bid_amount}.{cont}

word.chosen: Muthandeni {player_id} amechagua neno '{word}' lenye thamani ya {word_value}.
